review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.901 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +18.2 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 224 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×1.012 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 17.1 points), the pick lost (-1u).

rundown: Eagles beat Wolves 90-53 at Physical Education Complex in Baltimore, MD in front of 2,874. Eagles led 47-23 at half-time and never looked back. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 99%).
Leading the way — Wolves: Treshawn Cody 17 pts, 2 ast, 9 reb. Eagles: Malik Shackleford 16 pts; Daveyon Lydner 3 ast; Hussain Williams 12 reb.
Where Eagles won it: they shot 55% to 25%, shot 36% from three to 11% and won the boards 47-35.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 9, 10:57 AM ET. It had Wolves 45% and Eagles 55%, projecting Wolves 65.8 – Eagles 67.2 (133 total, Eagles by 1.4).

Final: Wolves 53 – Eagles 90. Right winner: it had Eagles at 55%.
